name: data-cap-example-enterprise-platform
description: Tier 3 -- Atlas, an org-wide work-management platform (TanStack Start + MongoDB/Mongoose) with three independently-owned capabilities (identity/projects/billing), a real running service, and two generated governance reports (litigation-evidence, audit-prep) plus a real --strict-docs/--strict-flow CI guard.

scripts.docs: data-cap --root . --include "src/**" --location src/generated/data.manifest.ts --docs docs/DATA.md --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --flow docs/flow --evidence docs/data.evidence.json
scripts.check: data-cap --root . --include "src/**" --location src/generated/data.manifest.ts --docs docs/DATA.md --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --flow docs/flow --evidence docs/data.evidence.json --check && tsx reports/litigation-evidence.ts --check && tsx reports/audit-prep.ts --check
